results.question: Give me Python code to download Bottom pressure recorder O1 (COSZO-BPR-O1) data from 2014-10-01 22:43 to 2014-10-02 00:33 UTC
results.code:
# pip install pandas requests
import io
import pandas as pd
import requests

START, END = '2014-10-01 22:43', '2014-10-02 00:33'   # UTC
# Station O1's visits (first and last sample, UTC) and their files
VISITS = [
    ('2014-10-01 22:43:55', '2014-10-02 00:33:39', 'https://library.ucsd.edu/dc/object/bb6529640g/_5_1.csv/download'),
    ('2014-10-02 06:15:30', '2014-10-02 08:06:38', 'https://library.ucsd.edu/dc/object/bb6529640g/_6_1.csv/download'),
    ('2014-10-03 21:25:31', '2014-10-04 03:28:48', 'https://library.ucsd.edu/dc/object/bb6529640g/_7_1.csv/download'),
    ('2015-10-21 05:05:30', '2015-10-21 07:08:14', 'https://library.ucsd.edu/dc/object/bb6529640g/_15_1.csv/download'),
    ('2016-06-04 15:57:15', '2016-06-04 18:22:44', 'https://library.ucsd.edu/dc/object/bb6529640g/_23_1.csv/download'),
    ('2017-09-06 10:58:00', '2017-09-06 12:56:44', 'https://library.ucsd.edu/dc/object/bb6529640g/_42_1.csv/download'),
]
NAMES = ["time1", "time2", "pressure1_kPa", "pressure2_kPa", "temperature1_C", "temperature2_C"]
t1, t2 = pd.Timestamp(START), pd.Timestamp(END)
parts = []
for a, b, url in VISITS:
    if pd.Timestamp(a) <= t2 and pd.Timestamp(b) >= t1:
        df = pd.read_csv(io.StringIO(requests.get(url, timeout=120).text), header=None, names=NAMES)
        for k in ("time1", "time2"):   # MATLAB datenumber: 719529 is 1970-01-01
            df[k] = pd.to_datetime((df[k] - 719529) * 86400, unit="s").dt.round("ms")
        parts.append(df[(df["time1"] >= t1) & (df["time1"] <= t2)])
if not parts:
    raise SystemExit("No O1 visit in the timeframe; its visits are " + "; ".join(f"{a} to {b}" for a, b, _ in VISITS))
out = pd.concat(parts).rename(columns={"time1": "time1_utc", "time2": "time2_utc"})
out.to_csv("ascpr_O1_pressure.csv", index=False)
print(len(out), "rows", out["time1_utc"].min(), "to", out["time1_utc"].max())
